info.title: Leywn
info.description:
Last Echo You Will Need — an all-in-one demo backend for APIs and services.

All endpoints support content negotiation: include `Accept: application/xml` to receive XML instead of the default JSON. Set `LEYWN_ONLY_JSON=true` to disable XML and always return JSON.

CORS headers are added to every response. Set `LEYWN_CORS_ORIGIN` to restrict the allowed origin (default: `*`).

Mock REST APIs are served under `/mocks` from JSON files — one folder per mock. Each renders its own OpenAPI at `/mocks/{mock}/openapi.json` with a Swagger UI page at `/docs/mocks/{mock}`, both linked from the home page.

post.summary: Exchange JWT — Bearer or RFC 8693 Token Exchange
post.description:
Supports two exchange modes:

**Bearer mode** (default): send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with any Content-Type. Returns the full echo payload plus `exchanged_token` and `claims`.

**RFC 8693 mode**: POST with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`. Returns a standards-compliant token exchange response with `access_token`, `issued_token_type`, `token_type`, and `expires_in`.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer JWT (used in Bearer mode; omit when using RFC 8693 form body)

get.summary: Echo with random fault injection (defaults via X-Chaos-* headers)
get.description: Reads chaos parameters from X-Chaos-* request headers. Defaults: error=10%, mangled=10%, latency=20% up to 2000ms.

parameters.name: X-Chaos-Error-Percentage
parameters.description: Probability (0-100) that a random 4xx/5xx status is returned instead of the echo. Values outside the range are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: X-Chaos-Mangled-Percentage
parameters.description: Probability (0-100) that the response body is truncated mid-stream into invalid JSON. Values outside the range are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: X-Chaos-Latency-Percentage
parameters.description: Probability (0-100) that an artificial delay is applied. Values outside the range are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: X-Chaos-Maximum-Latency
parameters.description: Upper bound in milliseconds (0-30000) for the injected delay. Values outside the range are rejected with 400 before any delay is applied.

parameters.name: mock

get.summary: List the records of a collection
get.description: Paged, sortable, searchable and filterable. The unpaged total is returned in the `X-Total-Count` header, alongside `X-Page`, `X-Page-Size` and `X-Total-Pages`.

parameters.name: mock
parameters.description: Name of the mock — the folder name under the mocks directory

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A top-level key of the mock's JSON file whose value is an array

parameters.name: _page
parameters.description: 1-based page number

parameters.name: _limit
parameters.description: Records per page. Capped by `LEYWN_MOCK_MAX_PAGE_SIZE` (default 200); a larger value is a 400 rather than a silent truncation.

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by

parameters.name: _order
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` (default) or `desc`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across every field of a record, including inside list fields. Limited to 128 characters.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Any other query parameter filters on the field of that name — `?city=Barcelona` returns only matching records. Comparison suffixes also work: `?maxGuests_gte=4` (at least), `_lte`, `_gt`, `_lt`, `_ne`, and `_like` for a case-insensitive substring match that also reaches into list fields (`?amenities_like=pool`). ISO-8601 values order correctly as text, so `?from_gte=2026-09-01&from_lte=2026-09-30` is a date range. At most `LEYWN_MOCK_MAX_FILTERS` (default 10) filters are honoured, `q` included.

400.description: Invalid paging, sorting or filter parameters

post.description: Held in memory only, never written to the file, and forgotten after `LEYWN_MOCK_ENTRY_TTL_SECONDS` (default 300). An `id` is generated when the body does not supply one; a supplied `id` that already exists is a 409.

507.description: This mock already holds `LEYWN_MOCK_MAX_NEW_ENTRIES` changes, or the total size of all changes is at `LEYWN_MOCK_MAX_OVERLAY_BYTES`

get.summary: List the related records of another collection
get.description: Follows the foreign key between two collections: `/mocks/accommodations/properties/prop-gothic-loft/availability` returns the availability rows whose `propertyId` matches. The field is discovered from the data (`propertyId`, `property_id`, …), so a collection with no field referencing the parent is a 404 rather than an empty list. Results accept the same paging, sorting, search and filter parameters as a plain collection read.

parameters.name: mock
parameters.description: Name of the mock — the folder name under the mocks directory

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A top-level key of the mock's JSON file whose value is an array

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The record's `id` field

parameters.name: child
parameters.description: A sibling collection holding a field that references this record

parameters.name: _page
parameters.description: 1-based page number

parameters.name: _limit
parameters.description: Records per page. Capped by `LEYWN_MOCK_MAX_PAGE_SIZE` (default 200); a larger value is a 400 rather than a silent truncation.

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by

parameters.name: _order
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` (default) or `desc`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across every field of a record, including inside list fields. Limited to 128 characters.

404.description: No such mock, collection or record, or no relation between the two collections
